凹口为浅圆弧内凹: 谷底圆滑、无明显尖角, 峰谷半径差约 8-12px(约为平均半径的 ±10%), 属浅波浪而非深方齿; 凹口与凸瓣数量相等、一一交替。相位读数存在张力: 底部条带(e007)显示 6 点方向附近为凹口、两侧约 7:30/4:30 为凸瓣顶; 顶部条带(e006)显示 11 点方向附近有凹口、12 点附近偏凸瓣。
中心为圆形通孔且与外轮廓同心; 孔内透出背景白色(e004 均值≈254.9, 判定为真孔而非浅色填充), 孔半径≈20px, 与凸瓣顶半径之比≈0.33、与凹谷半径之比≈0.40(精确比例待测量)。
环带为单一纯绿色填充, 无渐变、描边或纹理: 独立采样 e005(67.9,187.9,99.2)与 e008(68,188,99)一致; 上方采样 e002(91,196,118)的偏亮可定量解释为框内混入约 12% 白色边缘像素(0.88×(68,188,99)+0.12×白≈实测值), 同时说明轮廓边缘存在窄抗锯齿过渡。

So near 12 o'clock (x=261) there's a lobe peak or slightly right of it, and a notch at ~10:30-11 (x≈243).

I can see: green with bumps/notches: there's a notch at around center-left (~x≈25-30 of 70 → original ~251-256), bump at left (~x≈10-15 → original ~236-241), and the yellow disc at right. Wait, looking at e007 image again: it shows green shape with white notch cutting in from bottom at around center-left, and the yellow disc at bottom-right. The notch appears at around 40-45% from left of the strip → original x ≈ 254-258. That's approximately 6 o'clock (x=261), slightly left → ~6:15 direction. Hmm.

So now with actual images: e006 shows notch at ~11 o'clock (up-left), lobe near 12. e007 shows notch at ~6-6:30 (down-slightly-left). 

If notch at ~11 o'clock (angle ~120° measured CCW from +x) and notch at ~6-6:30 (~265-270°): difference ≈ 145°. With N=8 (45° spacing): 145/45 ≈ 3.2 — not integer. With N=7 (51.4°): 145/51.4 ≈ 2.8 — not integer either. Hmm. With N=8 and phase offset: notches at 112.5° + 45k: 112.5, 157.5, 202.5, 247.5, 292.5, 337.5, 22.5, 67.5. Bottom notch candidates: 247.5° (~7:15) or 292.5° (~4:45). I read ~265-270 — between. Eh, angle measurement from these small images is unreliable.

Let me look at e003 more carefully — the 122×123 image. I can see the full gear. Description of what I see in e003: green gear, white hole center slightly... hole appears centered. Notches: I can identify white indentations at: top-left (~10:30), top-right (~1:30), right (~3:30), bottom-right (~5:30), bottom (~6:30-7), left (~9). That's 6 visible + possibly one hidden by yellow overlap (bottom-right ~5). Total 7? 8? The yellow disc covers the bottom-right lobe region, hiding maybe one notch and one lobe.

Counting lobes in e003: lobe at 12 (top, rounded), lobe at ~1-2? Actually top area: from the image, top edge: there's a lobe roughly at 12, notch at ~1:30, lobe at ~2:30-3, notch at ~3:30-4, lobe at ~4:30-5 (partially near yellow), notch ~5:30, lobe ~6:30?, notch ~7:30, lobe ~8:30-9, notch ~9:30-10, lobe ~10:30-11, notch ~11:30-12? 

Hmm. Honestly the standard interpretation of these puzzle-piece/gear icons (this looks like Google Material style puzzle/gear pieces): the classic "cog" icon used here has 7 or 8 lobes. Looking at the overall silhouette in e001/e003, my best count remains ~7-8.

Actually — wait. Looking at e003 image very carefully: I can discern the boundary shape. The gear shows: bump top-left (~10-11), bump top-right (~12:30-1:30), bump right (~3), bump bottom-right (~4:30-5), bump bottom-left (~6:30-7), bump left-bottom (~8-9), bump left-top (~9:30-10:30)... and notches between: at ~12 (slightly right of top?), ~2, ~3:45, ~5:45, ~7:45, ~9:15, ~11. Hmm that suggests ~7 bumps + ~7 notches with a notch near 12? But e006 showed lobe near 12 (x≈261-266)...

Let me re-examine e006 (70×38 strip, original x 226-296): The image shows a green shape. Top edge: from left, green starts at mid-height of strip, edge rises, there's a notch (white wedge) at around 20-25% from left, then rises to a summit at ~55-65% from left, then slight descent to right edge. Summit at x≈261-271. The strip center x=261 → summit ≈ 12 o'clock or slightly right (12:05-12:15). Notch at original x≈241-246 → angle: dx=-17, dy≈-55 → atan2(55,-17) ≈ 107° → ~10:45-11:00. Hmm.

And e007 (70×37 strip, original x 226-296, y 432-469): The image shows: green mass, bottom edge: from left edge, boundary descends to a notch at ~35-45% from left (original x≈251-258), rises slightly, then another lobe at ~65% (original ~272), and at bottom-right the yellow disc and white gap. The yellow disc's top-left edge enters at bottom-right corner. Notch at x≈254 → dx=-7 → angle ≈ 262° (~6:20). Lobe at x≈272 → dx=+11 → angle ≈ 281°? That can't be — lobe and notch 19° apart? No — the bottom lobe right of the notch: if notch at 262°, next lobe (CW) at ~247°? Hmm I'm confusing myself with directions.

OK let me think in screen coords: angle from center, 0°=right(+x), 90°=up(−y in screen), 180°=left, 270°=down. Notch readings: e006 notch at dx≈-17, dy(screen)≈-55 → up-left → angle ≈ 107°. e007 notch at dx≈-7, dy≈+55 → down-slightly-left → angle ≈ 262°. If N=8, notch spacing 45°: from 107° going clockwise (decreasing angle): 107→62→17→332→287→242. Notch at 262? Not in list (242 and 287 are). From 262 counterclockwise: 262→217→172→127→82→37→352→307. 107 not in list. Inconsistent under N=8.

If N=7, spacing 51.43°: from 107°: 107→55.6→4.3→313→261.7→210→158.7→107. Notch at 261.7 ≈ my 262 reading!! And 107 ≈ my e006 reading!! Both fit N=7 with notch phase ≈ 107° ≈ 10:25!

Whoa. Let me double-check: N=7, notches at 107 + k·51.43 (mod 360): 107, 158.4, 209.9, 261.3, 312.7, 4.1, 55.6. So notches at: 107° (10:27), 158° (9:45... wait let me convert: 180°=9 o'clock (left), 135°=10:30, 158°≈ between 10:30 and 9:00 → ~9:47), 210° (≈8:30), 261° (~6:17), 313° (~4:37), 4° (3:08), 56° (~1:50). No: 132.8 is between 158 and 107, yes lobe at ~10:34).

Hmm wait, that gives lobe at 81° ≈ 12:18 — matches e006 summit slightly right of 12! And lobe at 132.8° ≈ 10:34... but e006 showed notch at ~107 (10:27). OK.

Now cross-check with e003 full view: notches predicted at 10:27, 9:47, 8:30, 6:17, 4:37, 3:08, 1:50. Hmm, my e003 reading said notch at ~1:30, ~3:30, ~5:30, ~6:30-7, ~9, ~10:30. Predicted: 1:50 ✓(~1:30-2), 3:08 (~3:30, eh), 4:37 (~5:30? off by ~50 min), 6:17 (~6:30 ✓), 8:30 (✓ ~8:30-9), 9:47 (~9-9:30, eh), 10:27 (✓ ~10:30). Roughly consistent within reading error!

7 lobes: at 12:18, 2:00, 3:40, 5:26, 7:09, 8:52, 10:34. e003 showed lobes near 12 ✓, ~2-3 ✓, ~4:30-5 (≈5:26, ok), ~6:30-7 (≈7:09, ok), ~8:30-9 (≈8:52, ok), ~10:30 (≈10:34 ✓), ~2:00 ✓.

So N=7 with notch phase ~107° fits BOTH strips and roughly the full view! But wait — visually, the gear in e001/e003... let me count lobes directly in e003 image: going around: top lobe (~12), upper-right lobe (~2), right lobe (~3:40), lower-right lobe (~5:30, partially obscured by yellow), bottom lobe (~7), left-bottom lobe (~9), upper-left lobe (~10:30). messages.content: 进入机制阶段 (revision 4)。核对回执： F1–F4、R1–R3 已登记， mechanisms 目录为空 —— 按 skill 需先提交完整机制定义。目录为空时首次定义与关联可同批提交 (bindings 上限每批 4 条)： 先保存 4 条机制并绑定 F1–F4, R1–R3 的绑定留待下一批 (依赖本批机制登记成功)：

reasoning_details.text:
我当前在机制阶段 (stage: mechanisms, revision 4)。回执确认:
- 观察已登记: F1-F4, R1-R3
- mechanisms 目录为空
- sketches 为空
- open_questions 和 gaps 已登记

现在需要:
1. 先保存机制 (mechanisms 参数提交完整定义, 目录为空时必须先提交机制定义)
2. 再用 bindings 关联到 F/R

根据 skill: "目录为空时, 先在 mechanisms 参数提交至少一条包含 id、name、method 的完整定义"。"首次定义与关联可以同批提交"。

所以我可以一次调用 save_mechanisms, 包含 mechanisms 定义 + bindings。

让我设计机制:

观察回顾:
- F1: 花瓣/齿轮形外轮廓, 7 凸瓣 + 7 凹口, 均匀交替, 峰半径≈61px, 谷半径≈49px, 谷/峰比≈0.80, 近圆形
- F2: 凹口浅圆弧内凹, 谷底圆滑, 峰谷差 8-12px, 相位凹口约 107°
- F3: 中心圆孔, 同心, r≈20px, 真孔
- F4: 纯绿色填充 (68,188,99), 无渐变, 边缘窄抗锯齿
- R1: 凸瓣凹口共享圆心与角周期, 同一闭合轮廓
- R2: 孔与外轮廓同心, 半径固定比例
- R3: 颜色填充由同一形状判定驱动, 一次符号/奇偶测试同时产生外边界与孔

候选机制设计 (针对 SDF 类过程式 shader):

M1: 极坐标正弦调制半径 (cosine-wavy circle SDF)
- method: 以圆心为原点建立极坐标, r(θ) = R0 + A·cos(N·(θ-φ0)), N 为瓣数, A 为幅度 (A>0 时凸瓣在 cos 峰处)。等等, 注意凹口相位: 凹口位于 107°, 意味着 cos(N(θ-φ)) 在 107° 处取最小值。设 r(θ) = R0 - A·cos(N·(θ - 107°)), 则 θ=107° 时 r = R0 - A (谷)。R0≈55, A≈6 (峰 61, 谷 49)。实际上 R0 = (61+49)/2 = 55, A = 6。
- 形状判定: 当像素到圆心距离 < r(θ) 且 > 孔半径 → 内部。
- 优点: 简单、参数少 (R0, A, N, φ0, r_hole); 谷底圆滑自然。缺点: 凸瓣顶也可能圆滑, 与"瓣顶较平/宽"的圆弧瓣形态可能不完全一致; 凹口剖面是正弦型。

M2: 基圆与瓣圆并集的圆弧花瓣 (union of base circle + N lobe circles, smooth)
- method: 基圆半径 R_base≈49-50 加上 N=7 个沿圆周均匀分布的凸瓣圆 (半径 r_lobe≈12-15, 圆心距 R_base) 取并集 (可用平滑并集 k 值控制凹口根部圆滑度), 形成经典"花瓣齿轮"。凹口由相邻瓣圆之间的基圆圆弧形成, 天然圆滑。
- 相位: 瓣圆中心角度 = 107° + 51.43°·k + 25.7° (凹口在 107°, 峰顶在凹口之间, 峰顶≈81° 与 132°? 等一下: 若凹口在 107°, 相邻峰顶在 107°±25.7° = 81.3° 和 132.7°。e006 观察峰顶≈81° 吻合! 好。
- 优点: 凹口为基圆弧、瓣顶为瓣圆弧, 更接近"圆弧齿轮"外观; 缺点: 参数稍多, 需 smooth min 控制。

M3: 圆环带 SDF + 中心圆孔差集 (annulus + hole subtraction)
- method: 外轮廓距离场 d_outer 与中心孔圆 d_hole, 最终遮罩 = d_outer < 0 AND d_hole > 0 (或 d_final = max(d_outer, -d_hole)); 一次性产生外边界与孔。可调孔半径比例。
- 覆盖 F3, R2, R3。

M4: 均匀纯色填充 + 屏幕空间导数抗锯齿 (flat fill + fwidth AA)
- method: 遮罩值 m 在边界处用 smoothstep(1px, 基于 length(fwidth(p)) 或 d/dpixel) 过渡, 内部输出常量绿色 RGB(68,188,99), 无渐变纹理。可调颜色与过渡宽度。
- 覆盖 F4, R3。

M5 (可选): 花瓣曲线的解析极坐标闭合形状 (generic polar loop) — 可能与 M1 重复, 不需要。

或者 M2 变体: "sinusoidal vs circular-arc" 都需要。让我用 4 个机制:
- M1: 正弦调制极坐标轮廓 (r(θ)=R0+A·cos(Nθ+φ))
- M2: 基圆+瓣圆平滑并集轮廓
- M3: 环带组合 (外轮廓与中心孔的布尔组合成遮罩)
- M4: 纯色填充与 fwidth 抗锯齿

bindings:
- F1 → M1, M2 (两种轮廓生成假设)
- F2 → M1, M2 (凹口剖面归属是 open question, 两个机制都作为候选)
- F3 → M3
- F4 → M4
- R1 → M1, M2 (同一条轮廓参数化下峰谷共享圆心与周期)
- R2 → M3
- R3 → M3, M4? R3 说颜色填充由同一形状判定驱动: 一次符号/奇偶测试同时产生外边界与中心孔。M3 是 max(d_outer, -d_hole) 组合 → 覆盖 R3。M4 是着色, 与 R3 的"同一形状判定"也相关, 但 R3 更关于形状判定而非着色。我把 R3 → M3 (主要), 也可以加 M4 因为最终 alpha 由同一 SDF 输出驱动。让我: R3 → M3, M4 (M4 提供同一遮罩驱动的纯色填充)。

实际上 R3: "颜色填充由同一形状判定驱动: 一次符号/奇偶测试同时产生外边界与中心孔, 环带内颜色处处相同。" → M3 (max 组合产生单一遮罩) 是核心; M4 (纯色填充) 也相关。R3 → [M3, M4]。

R2: "中心孔与外轮廓同心, 孔半径与外轮廓半径在同一参数化下保持固定比例" → M3。

F1: 外轮廓形状 → M1, M2。
F2: 凹口浅圆弧 → M1, M2。
F3: 中心孔 → M3。
F4: 纯色 → M4。

每次 binding 替换该目标的完整候选清单。首次绑定就把全部候选列出。

save_mechanisms 参数:
- mechanisms: [M1, M2, M3, M4] (最多四项, 正好 4)
- bindings: 7 个 target (F1-F4, R1-R3)? bindings maxItems 没有写, 让我看 schema: "bindings": {"default": [], "items": {...}, "maxItems": 4, ...}。哦 bindings maxItems 4! 每批最多 4 条 binding。

所以我需要分两批: 第一批 mechanisms + 前 4 个 bindings (F1, F2, F3, F4), 第二批 bindings (R1, R2, R3)。

批次 1: save_mechanisms with mechanisms (4) + bindings [F1, F2, F3, F4]
批次 2: save_mechanisms with bindings [R1, R2, R3] (mechanisms 空)

然后核对回执, 再 advance 到 sketch 阶段。

机制定义细节:

M1: name: "正弦调制极坐标花瓣轮廓" 
method: "以圆心为原点取极坐标, 轮廓半径 r(θ)=R0+A·cos(N·(θ-φ_v)), N 为瓣数(候选 7), φ_v 为某凹口方位(≈107°), R0≈55px 为平均半径, A≈6px 为幅度, 谷/峰半径比由 A/R0 决定(≈0.89? 等等)

等一下: 谷/峰半径比 = 49/61 ≈ 0.80。R0 = 55, A = 6 → 谷 = 49, 峰 = 61, 比 = 0.803。好。

幅度 A≈6px (峰谷差 12px)。F2 说峰谷差 8-12px, A = 差/2 = 4-6px。取 A≈5-6。

conditions: 瓣数 N 为待校准参数(优先 N=7, 备选 N=8)
峰谷均圆滑、无明显平顶时适用
mechanisms.method: 以圆心为原点建立极坐标, 外轮廓半径 r(θ)=R0+A·cos(N·(θ−φ_v)): N 为凸瓣数(候选 7), φ_v 为某一凹口的方位角(≈107°), R0≈55px 为平均半径, A≈5-6px 为调制幅度(峰≈R0+A, 谷≈R0−A, 谷/峰比≈0.80)。像素在 r(θ) 之内判定为实体。可调因素: N、相位 φ_v、幅度 A、平均半径 R0。
mechanisms.name: 正弦调制极坐标花瓣轮廓

conditions: 瓣顶呈圆弧帽、凹口为宽圆弧的齿轮形
瓣数 N 与瓣圆几何需渲染校准
mechanisms.method: 取基圆(半径 Rb≈49-50px)加上 N=7 个沿圆周均匀分布的凸瓣圆(瓣心距圆心≈Rb, 瓣圆半径 r_l≈13-15px)的平滑并集(smooth-union, 混合宽度 k 控制凹口根部圆滑度与瓣侧过渡): 凹口是相邻瓣圆之间露出的基圆圆弧, 瓣顶是瓣圆圆弧帽。瓣心方位相对凹口方位偏移半个角周期(凹口≈107° 时瓣心≈81.3°/132.7°…), 使凹口落在观察方位。可调因素: N、Rb、r_l、k、整体相位。
mechanisms.name: 基圆+瓣圆平滑并集轮廓

conditions: 孔与外轮廓同心
仅一个中心内边界
mechanisms.method: 对每个像素求外轮廓符号距离 d_out(由 M1 或 M2 生成)与中心孔圆的符号距离 d_hole(孔半径≈20px, 与外轮廓同圆心), 组合成单一遮罩距离 d=max(d_out, −d_hole): d<0 为环带实体, 同时产生外边界与中心孔。孔径以外径比例参数化(孔半径≈0.33×瓣顶半径)。可调因素: 孔半径或比例、圆心位置。
mechanisms.name: 环带遮罩: 外轮廓与同心孔布尔组合

conditions: 单一纯色 UI 圆片, 无内部纹理
背景合成方式(透明或白底)由场景组装决定
mechanisms.method: 遮罩值 m 由遮罩距离 d 的符号经 smoothstep 生成, 过渡宽度取屏幕空间导数(fwidth 类)约 1 像素实现窄抗锯齿; 环带内部输出常量绿色 RGB≈(68,188,99)(sRGB), 无渐变、无描边、无纹理。可调因素: 颜色值、过渡宽度、输出到背景的合成方式。
mechanisms.name: 纯色填充与屏幕空间导数抗锯齿

mechanism_refs.reason: 单一 r(θ) 参数化直接给出 N 个均匀交替的峰谷, 峰半径 R0+A≈61px 与谷半径 R0−A≈49px 可由 R0、A 直接对准观察值。
基圆+均匀分布瓣圆的平滑并集同样产生瓣数相等、均匀交替的近圆形齿轮轮廓, 瓣顶半径与谷半径分别可调。
正弦型谷天然圆滑无尖角, 幅度 A≈5-6px 给出浅凹(峰谷差≈10-12px), 相位项对准凹口方位≈107°。
凹口为相邻瓣圆之间露出的基圆圆弧, 谷底圆滑; 若原图凹口属圆弧型剖面则由此机制拟合。
同心圆孔以差集从环带中减去, 孔半径独立可调并可与外径保持固定比例。
常量绿色填充加屏幕空间导数约 1px 的边缘过渡, 对应观察到的纯色与窄抗锯齿。

messages.content: 收到拒绝回执： M3.method 文本中出现裸写 'M1' 未标记引用， 整批未保存。按 skill 定位： 字段路径 `mechanisms.M3.method` → 原因是方法文本内引用了未登记 ID → 修复方式为改写为描述性文字 (机制目录尚未建立， 不用 `[[M1]]` 交叉引用)， 其余机制与绑定保持不变， 整批重新提交：

reasoning_details.text:
The submission was rejected: unmarked object reference 'M1' appeared in mechanisms.M3.method_or_conditions. The text mentions 'M1' or 'M2' which needs to be rewritten. The rejection means the entire batch was not saved. I need to fix the M3 method text, removing the reference to M1/M2 (or rewriting it as a descriptive statement rather than referencing an ID).

According to the skill: upon receiving a "mechanism reference does not exist" rejection, the entire batch is not saved; first complete the full definitions of the missing mechanisms, then submit the association. Here the problem is an unmarked object reference in the method text. I should avoid writing "M1" or "M2" in the method text — either use [[M1]] explicit markup (but that's the rule for body text), or change it to descriptive language. Inside the method field, describing "the outer contour can be generated by either of two contour mechanisms (sine-modulated polar coordinates or base circle + lobe-circle smooth union)" would suffice.

Modify M3's method: "For each pixel compute the signed distance d_out to the outer contour (outer contour SDF generated by a separate contour mechanism) and the signed distance d_hole to the center hole circle..."

Also need to check whether other mechanisms also have similar bare references. The method of M1 doesn't reference others. The method of M2 doesn't. The method of M4 says "mask value m is generated from the sign of mask distance d via smoothstep" — "d" is a variable name, not an object ID, it's fine. But it says "mask distance d" — d is not a registered ID, it's just a variable, OK.

Re-examine whether the binding reason has bare references. The reason field: F1's reason mentions "single r(θ) parametrization" "base circle + evenly distributed lobe circles", with no ID references. F2's reason doesn't mention IDs. F3's reason doesn't. F4's reason doesn't. Good.

But note the binding's mechanism_refs only have id and reason, reason is plain text, may also perform unmarked reference detection? In the previous batch it was only reported for mechanisms.M3.method_or_conditions[0]. To be safe, avoid M1/M2 in all text. There's no ID in the reason text.

Resubmit the corrected batch.

mechanism_refs.reason: 单一 r(θ) 参数化直接给出 N 个均匀交替的峰谷, 峰半径 R0+A≈61px 与谷半径 R0−A≈49px 可由 R0、A 直接对准观察值。
基圆+均匀分布瓣圆的平滑并集同样产生瓣数相等、均匀交替的近圆形齿轮轮廓, 瓣顶半径与谷半径分别可调。
正弦型谷天然圆滑无尖角, 幅度 A≈5-6px 给出浅凹(峰谷差≈10-12px), 相位项对准凹口方位≈107°。
凹口为相邻瓣圆之间露出的基圆圆弧, 谷底圆滑; 若原图凹口属圆弧型剖面则由此机制拟合。
同心圆孔以差集从环带中减去, 孔半径独立可调并可与外径保持固定比例。
常量绿色填充加屏幕空间导数约 1px 的边缘过渡, 对应观察到的纯色与窄抗锯齿。

conditions: 瓣数 N 为待校准参数(优先 N=7, 备选 N=8)
峰谷均圆滑、无明显平顶时适用
mechanisms.method: 以圆心为原点建立极坐标, 外轮廓半径 r(θ)=R0+A·cos(N·(θ−φ_v)): N 为凸瓣数(候选 7), φ_v 为某一凹口的方位角(≈107°), R0≈55px 为平均半径, A≈5-6px 为调制幅度(峰≈R0+A, 谷≈R0−A, 谷/峰比≈0.80)。像素在 r(θ) 之内判定为实体。可调因素: N、相位 φ_v、幅度 A、平均半径 R0。
mechanisms.name: 正弦调制极坐标花瓣轮廓

conditions: 瓣顶呈圆弧帽、凹口为宽圆弧的齿轮形
瓣数 N 与瓣圆几何需渲染校准
mechanisms.method: 取基圆(半径 Rb≈49-50px)加上 N=7 个沿圆周均匀分布的凸瓣圆(瓣心距圆心≈Rb, 瓣圆半径 r_l≈13-15px)的平滑并集(smooth-union, 混合宽度 k 控制凹口根部圆滑度与瓣侧过渡): 凹口是相邻瓣圆之间露出的基圆圆弧, 瓣顶是瓣圆圆弧帽。瓣心方位相对凹口方位偏移半个角周期(凹口≈107° 时瓣心≈81.3°/132.7°…), 使凹口落在观察方位。可调因素: N、Rb、r_l、k、整体相位。
mechanisms.name: 基圆+瓣圆平滑并集轮廓

conditions: 孔与外轮廓同心
仅一个中心内边界
mechanisms.method: 对每个像素求外轮廓符号距离 d_out 与中心孔圆的符号距离 d_hole(孔半径≈20px, 与外轮廓同圆心), 组合成单一遮罩距离 d=max(d_out, −d_hole): d<0 为环带实体, 同时产生外边界与中心孔。外轮廓距离可由正弦调制极坐标或基圆+瓣圆平滑并集任一轮廓机制生成, 本机制只负责孔与环带的布尔组合。孔径以外径比例参数化(孔半径≈0.33×瓣顶半径)。可调因素: 孔半径或比例、圆心位置。
mechanisms.name: 环带遮罩: 外轮廓与同心孔布尔组合

conditions: 单一纯色 UI 圆片, 无内部纹理
背景合成方式(透明或白底)由场景组装决定
mechanisms.method: 遮罩值 m 由遮罩距离 d 的符号经 smoothstep 生成, 过渡宽度取屏幕空间导数(fwidth 类)约 1 像素实现窄抗锯齿; 环带内部输出常量绿色 RGB≈(68,188,99)(sRGB), 无渐变、无描边、无纹理。可调因素: 颜色值、过渡宽度、输出到背景的合成方式。
mechanisms.name: 纯色填充与屏幕空间导数抗锯齿
